sources.title: Furbearer Trapping Seasons — 2026 Connecticut Hunting and Trapping Guide (CT DEEP web chapter)
sources.notes: Live DEEP web version of the guide's trapping chapter (page content last updated January 2026; checked 2026-11-15). Season table, pelt-tagging list and 2026 tagging schedule, fisher/gray-fox carcass collection, protected-species pelt rule, and state-land trapping permits ($60/unit, valid November-March 31) all match guide p.36 exactly.

license_summary.trapping_license: Trapping license required; available 24/7 via Connecticut's Online Outdoor Licensing System or at licensed retailers/town halls.
license_summary.pelt_tagging: Beaver, river otter, red fox, gray fox, wild mink, coyote, and fisher pelts must be tagged by DEEP before sale/exchange/gift/disposal/retention (by the last scheduled tagging date of the season).
license_summary.fisher_carcass: Fisher carcass submission to the Wildlife Division is mandatory.
license_summary.state_land: State-land trapping permits $60 per unit (east/west of the Connecticut River), valid November through March 31.

verification.confirmation_notes: RE-VERIFIED 2026-11-15 against (1) the 2026 CT Hunting and Trapping Guide PDF, p.36 Furbearer Seasons table (fresh download byte-identical to the archived copy), and (2) the live CT DEEP 'Furbearer Trapping Seasons' web chapter. Every row confirmed unchanged: otter Jan 1-Mar 15 & Nov 8-Dec 31 (limit 8); beaver Jan 1-Mar 31 & Dec 1-Dec 31 (no limit); mink/muskrat/weasel/coyote/gray fox/red fox/raccoon/opossum/skunk Jan 1-Mar 15 & Nov 8-Dec 31 (no limits); fisher Nov 20-Dec 31 (limit 2, carcass submission mandatory); pelt-tagging species list (beaver, river otter, red fox, gray fox, wild mink, coyote, fisher) and hunter-reporting alternative for fox/coyote (online or 1-877-337-4868); gray fox carcass submission requested (voluntary); state-land permits $60/unit valid November-March 31; bobcat confirmed PROTECTED (no open season) via the protected-species pelt rule. No date, limit, zone, or note in any species row required correction.
known_gaps: STILL PROVISIONAL for one reason only: CT publishes calendar-year guides, and the 2027 Connecticut Hunting and Trapping Guide (which will set the January 1-March 15, 2027 furbearer dates — the second half of the 2026-27 trapping season) had NOT been published as of 2026-11-15. Only the two published calendar-2026 segments are modeled; nothing about 2027 is inferred. provisional stays true until the 2027 guide is out and the Jan-Mar 2027 segment is verified and added.
Scientific names are standard taxonomy, NOT stated in the guide; all marked scientific_name_verified=false.
